title: Run Submission Attempt
description: Immutable submission-attempt record for correction re-entry. The base run_submissions row is unique per run and never rewritten; a correction that passes validation creates a new attempt row here. Publication binds the latest passing attempt.

base_submission_id.description: The original immutable run_submissions row this attempt extends.

attempt_ordinal.description: 1 for the first correction attempt, 2 for the second, etc.

submission_payload_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the submission payload JSON (the closure chain and candidate artifacts).

correction_command_id.description: The OutputCorrectionCommand that authorized this attempt.

attempt_status.description: The outcome of this attempt's validation/promotion cycle.

validation_attempt_id.description: The ValidationAttempt that evaluated this submission attempt, if validation ran.
